paragraphs: Excellence Honoured

GACL’s remarkable journey has been marked by numerous achievements. In its relentless pursuit of excellence, GACL has attained several significant milestones, earning the company prestigious awards and recognitions in the chemical industry. These accolades stand as a testament to GACL’s commitment to maintaining high standards and innovation in its field.
National CSR Award from World HRD Congress for adopting best CSR practices

GACL Foundation Trust, the CSR arm of Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited, has been honoured with the National CSR Award for adopting best CSR practices through our Home for Mentally Differently-abled Children (HMDC) Project at the CSR Conclave organized by the World HRD Congress in Bangalore.
Awarded 1st prize at 2nd GEO Excellence Awards 2024 for CSR Initiatives

Awarded the Runner Up Trophy at the Gujarat Cleaner Production Award for the Year 2017-18 by the Forests and Environment Department, Government of Gujarat, for the large-scale sector (highly polluting) in September 2024.

GACL Foundation Trust, the CSR arm of Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited, has been honoured with the National CSR Award for adopting best CSR practices through our Home for Mentally Differently-abled Children (HMDC) Project at the CSR Conclave organized by the World HRD Congress in Bangalore.

National Safety Council of India Safety Awards – 2025 awarded the prestigious “Certificate of Merit” for the Manufacturing Sector (Group B) to GACL Vadodara Complex in recognition of appreciable achievement in Occupational Safety & Health during 2022–2024.

Awarded the Runner Up Trophy at the Gujarat Cleaner Production Award for the Year 2017-18 by the Forests and Environment Department, Government of Gujarat, for the large-scale sector (highly polluting) in September 2024.
Awarded 1st prize at 2nd Gujarat Employers’ Organisation (GEO) Excellence Award 2024 in the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) category for Large Enterprises in March 2024.

GACL has been honoured with the prestigious National Award for its Dahej Complex under the category of Top Performer Designated Consumer for the Chlor Alkali Sector of Perform Achieve & Trade (PAT) Cycle II under the National Mission for Enhanced Energy Efficiency (NMEEE) on the occasion of the 21st BEE Day and the celebration of the 1st Decade of the PAT Scheme—an initiative by the Ministry of Power, Government of India in March 2023.

GACL was honoured with “Best Digital Transformation in Public Sector” by GESIA (Gujarat Electronics & Software Industries Association) Annual Awards 2022 (12th Edition) – Recognizing Excellence of Gujarat’s ICT Industry in Oct 2022.
The Certificate of Merit by the GST Department, Ministry of Finance, Government of India in July 2022, for Best Compliance on the occasion of completing 5 years of the GST Era.

17th National Award 2019 from the Institute of Cost Accountants of India for Excellence in Cost Management in April 2022. Significantly, winning this prestigious recognition is a rare distinction achieved by GACL, as it has won this National Award consecutively for three years: 2017, 2018, and 2019, under the category of Manufacturing – Public – Medium.
1st Runners-up in the ‘Annual Award for Outstanding Young Managers’ by the Baroda Management Association in March 2022.
‘HR Corona Warriors Award’ in August 2021, from the Society of Human Resource Professionals (SHRP), in recognition of impactful contributions during the Covid-19 Pandemic.
‘Strategic Performance Award’ for the second consecutive year from the Governance Now 8th PSU Awards in July 2021.
16th National Award from the Institute of Cost Accountants of India for Excellence in Cost Management in October 2019.
15th National Award from the Institute of Cost Accountants of India for Excellence in Cost Management in September 2018.
Tally-GHKC & GreEnv Contest 2016 – 17 Award as the winner for Vadodara Complex and the second Runner-up for Dahej Complex conducted by the Baroda Productivity Council in 2017.

Safety Awards 2015 – Certificate of Appreciation awarded by the National Safety Council of India in 2016 for recognition of appreciable achievement in Occupational Safety & Health during the Assessment period of three years – 2012 – 2014.

Safety Awards – 2013 – “SURAKSHA PURASKAR” awarded by the National Safety Council of India for developing and implementing very effective management systems and procedures for its Vadodara Complex in October, 2014.
CHEMEXCIL Award 2010-11 awarded for Outstanding Export Performance by the Export Promotion Council, set up by the Ministry of Commerce & Industries, Government of India in August, 2013.

National Safety Award 2011 was awarded to our Vadodara and Dahej Complexes for Outstanding Performance in Industrial Safety by the Ministry for Labour & Employment, Government of India in September, 2013.
